[[runners]]
  [runners.kubernetes]
    helper_image = "ghcr.io/vaskozl/gitlab-runner-helper:latest"
    cpu_request = "500m"
    cpu_limit = "1"
    memory_request = "300Mi"
    memory_limit = "2Gi"
    service_cpu_request = "100m"
    service_cpu_limit = "1"
    service_memory_request = "50Mi"
    service_memory_limit = "1Gi"
    helper_cpu_request = "5m"
    helper_cpu_limit = "500m"
    helper_memory_request = "50Mi"
    helper_memory_limit = "200Mi"
    # Used by dind
    privileged = true
    [[runners.kubernetes.volumes.empty_dir]]
      name = "docker-emptydir"
      mount_path = "/var/run"
      medium = "Memory"
    [[runners.kubernetes.volumes.pvc]]
      name = "apk-repo-pvc"
      mount_path = "/apks"
    [runners.kubernetes.node_selector]
      "kubernetes.io/arch" = "amd64"

echo "Cleaning up images on node $(hostname)" &&
apk add --no-cache curl &&
curl -LO https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/cri-tools/releases/download/v1.31.1/crictl-v1.31.1-linux-amd64.tar.gz &&
tar -xvf crictl-* &&
mv crictl /usr/local/bin/ &&
crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/containerd/containerd.sock rmi --prune &&
echo "Cleanup completed successfully on node $(hostname)" &&
sleep 5 &&
exit 0
